featured_reviews.name: komal dedhia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I started prenatal sessions with Pooja from my 4th month, and it’s been a wonderful experience. My stamina has improved, I’ve felt active throughout, and my weight has been well managed.

She shares in-depth knowledge, including helpful sessions on labour and breastfeeding, which made a big difference. She has a great way of gently pushing you beyond your comfort zone, which has led to so many positive changes in my strength and overall well-being just the right amount to see real results.

And not to forget the delicious healthy smoothie after class!

Overall, Pooja’s class is a must during pregnancy. Highly recommend for every mom-to-be 🤍

featured_reviews.name: aarya mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Training with Pooja has been the best for me and my body. I have seen a change in my body from the first 5 weeks of joining her and all her innovative ideas for workout have helped me actually like what I’m doing. She is amazing at what she does and i would recommend her to every woman out there.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Karia
featured_reviews.review_text: I’m so grateful for my prenatal coach Pooja Haria! She has been a constant support throughout my pregnancy — guiding me with safe and effective workouts, keeping me active, and helping me stay fit and healthy. Thanks to her, I’ve been able to manage my weight gain in a balanced way while also feeling strong and confident. What I appreciated most were all the lectures and knowledge she shared about pregnancy — from fitness and nutrition to overall well-being. Her constant support, motivation, and care have made this journey so much smoother and more confident for me. Highly recommend her to any mom-to-be looking for the right guidance during pregnancy! 💕

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loving my experience here! The workouts are fun, engaging, and never feel boring. What I really appreciate is how personalized everything is and how supportive the environment feels. Pooja is knowledgeable and motivating, and you can see how much she genuinely cares. I'm having a lot of fun and can already feel a positive change in my body, honestly feel younger and more energetic. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: roshani bhandari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pooja will truly be your pregnancy partner throughout the prenatal journey with workouts or answering questions or sharing here really in depth classes about different things you need to learn for birth and after.
I feel so comfortable even so close to my expected due date I can only attribute it all to training consistently with her! Thank you so much for making my pregnancy so comfortable and fun while making me feel so strong

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Kirane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve had the pleasure of working with Pooja Haria through her classes conducted at North Indian Association (NIA). Her classes have always been a rewarding experience. She brings incredible energy, knowledge, and encouragement to each session, making every class both challenging and enjoyable.

I have been associated with Pooja Haria since 2019 and what see consistently since then and I love about her is that she makes all members of the batch comfortable and motivated, regardless of our fitness level. Her workouts are carefully designed to push us while always keeping things safe and accessible for everyone. Her attention to form, combined with her enthusiastic approach, has helped me loose weight, build strength, endurance, and confidence.

If you’re looking for a fitness coach who inspires you to keep coming back and consistently gives her all to help you succeed, I can’t recommend Pooja Haria enough. She has a real talent for creating an inclusive, enjoyable environment that makes working out something to look forward to!

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fitness by Pooja Haria
"A good coach can change a game. A great coach can change a life."
This quote truly reflects our coach, Pooja Haria.
I want to express how deeply we appreciate the investment you’ve made in our lives. I feel incredibly lucky to have a coach who inspires me every day to become better than I was the day before. You’ve taught me so much—not just in fitness, but in life—and have always gone beyond to show genuine care and support for your team.
I honestly don’t know what I would have achieved without you. Even though your workouts can be challenging, they have strengthened both my body and mind in ways I never imagined. You are an incredible trainer, and I am truly grateful for everything you do.
Your encouragement and constant motivation have pushed me to heights I never thought possible. Thank you for inspiring me to strive for excellence in everything I do. Your leadership and sportsmanship are truly admirable, and you always bring out the best in me.
It is a blessing to have such a dedicated, energetic, and compassionate trainer in my life. You helped me identify my weaknesses and transform them into strengths. If anyone deserves a standing ovation, it’s you.
Thank you for helping me discover my potential and reach new heights. I will always be grateful.

featured_reviews.name: aastha tibrewal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I started with Pooja in my second trimester of my second pregnancy and there has been no looking back. I am very passionate about whatever I do but if you find a coach equally or even more charged up and passionate, you hit a jackpot! The journey has been incredibly amazing!
Pooja's talent and approach to the workout plan is really inspiring. She leaves no stone unturned to do the best for her client. Every session is unique with new workouts. She breaks all pregnancy myths gracefully. She is instantly creative to plan out new stuff with new props keep each session fun. I have always looked forward to each session. She has a holistic approach to plan the workouts and also understands the medical needs of her clients. I had aqua and gym sessions both with her throughout and it was absolute joy. I would definitely like to believe that a lot of health issues generally faced by pregnant women didn't crop up because of the workout regime with Pooja.
She has immense knowledge not just in papers but in practical too about every bit of pregnancy and is able to share tips and tricks through out, giving all the comfort to her clients.
So whoever is reading this, she might make you work out hard but it will all be worth it.

featured_reviews.name: Priyal Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
One More Rep Gym is honestly one of the best fitness places I’ve been to. The trainers here are extremely knowledgeable, motivating, and genuinely invested in your progress. They guide you properly, correct your form, and push you just the right amount.

featured_reviews.review_text: Love this place..crazy workout sessions with Roshan sirjee and prince, Sachin..all the trainers are super fantastic..for a person who has not been on any fitness journey to a person who doesn’t like missing workouts..all thanks to OMR for this amazing transformation..cross fit training’s are so refreshing and love the kick boxing session..❤️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Purswani
featured_reviews.review_text: It's the most under-rated gym/fitness studio I have ever experienced. Been here for 4 months and I can't get enough of it. Whether you are a fitness enthusiast or endurance athlete (marathoner, ironman or hyrox aspirant) this place will shape you for each challenge.

featured_reviews.name: prashant kashikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I checked the reviews, and I noticed one comment saying that Roshan sir focuses more on his competition preparation and doesn’t pay attention to clients. But I completely disagree. In my experience, it’s the opposite.

Roshan sir manages everything so well — his own competition training and his clients — and still gives us full guidance. In fact, he even motivates us by saying that we should also try something in life, maybe even participate in a competition. That mindset itself inspires confidence. Personally, I feel extremely motivated every time I talk to Roshan sir.

One More Rep Gym is not just a gym — it feels like a family.
Thank you, Roshan sir. 🙏🙏

featured_reviews.name: Kaustubh Vishe
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely love training at One More Rep! The vibe is energetic, the workouts are challenging, and the results are real. Special shout-out to Roshan Sir for his structured training and constant motivation, and to Dnyanada Ma’am for her patience, form correction, and cheerful energy. They make fitness fun and sustainable. Definitely a 5-star studio!

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Saroj
